exposure: NTEP location (abdominal, cervical, cesarean scar, interstitial fallopian tube, heterotopic, ovarian)
types of treatment (medical treatment including methotrexate single/multiple doses or direct injection, surgery)
cohort: The study included 60 cases of non-tubal ectopic pregnancy (NTEP) admitted to the University of Campinas (UNICAMP) Women's hospital.
finding: Medical treatment for non-tubal ectopic pregnancy (NTEP) had a 73.7% success rate, similar to tubal EP, while severe complications occurred in 20% of cases and were associated with hemodynamic instability at admission, not NTEP location.
mod_finding: Cesarean scar NTEP cases were primarily treated with surgery, indicating an influence of prior cesarean delivery on the management approach for this specific type of ectopic pregnancy.
